title: Method, Mind, and Morality: How People Make Sense of Artificial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2608.24748v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can humans make sense of the rapid takeoff of artificial intelligence (AI)? We studied the sensemaking dynamics of AI through an open-ended, mixed-methods study with computational text analysis of millions of AI-related newspaper articles and social media posts grounded in 57 semi-structured interviews with AI professionals in 2021 and 2023--before and after the recent surge of public interest. We identify a range of sociological frames (interpretive schemas that structure collective cognition) and show how AI professionals use frames to address significant cognitive challenges, such as assigning responsibility for societal impacts. We develop a framework of three primary debates across which frames are adopted and contested: (i) the $\textit{method}$ of AI development, between frames of top-down expert systems and bottom-up emergent capabilities, (ii) the $\textit{mind}$ of an AI system, ranging from a passive tool to a humanlike

translated_title: 方法、心智与道德：人们如何理解人工智能
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24748v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人类如何理解人工智能（AI）的快速崛起？我们通过一项开放式、混合方法的研究，对2021年和2023年（公众兴趣最近激增前后）数百万篇与AI相关的报纸文章和社交媒体帖子进行了计算文本分析，并基于对AI专业人士的57次半结构化访谈，研究了AI的认知动态。我们识别出一系列社会学框架（构建集体认知的解释性图式），并展示了AI专业人士如何利用这些框架来应对重要的认知挑战，例如为社会影响分配责任。我们开发了一个框架，涵盖三个主要辩论领域，在这些领域中，框架被采纳和争论：（i）AI开发的“方法”，在自上而下的专家系统和自下而上的涌现能力框架之间；（ii）AI系统的“心智”，范围从被动工具到类人智能体；（iii）以及（未完整显示的第三点，涉及道德层面）。
tldr: 本研究通过分析数百万篇AI相关文章和社交媒体帖子及访谈AI专业人士，揭示了人们如何通过社会学框架理解AI，并提出了围绕AI开发方法、系统心智和道德责任的三个核心辩论。
en_tdlr: This study, analyzing millions of AI-related articles and posts alongside interviews with AI professionals, reveals how people make sense of AI through sociological frames, identifying three core debates over AI development methods, system minds, and moral responsibility.
